title: Burns Philp Building, Normanton

buildingCutout.basis: The mapped Normanton Information Centre roof includes both covered street edges.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged Copernicus GLO-30 DSM sampled at the Landsborough Street approach in the mapped warehouse frame.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap Normanton Information Centre footprint and Queensland Heritage Register entry 602781

identities.name: Burns Philp Building, Normanton
identities.address: Corner of Landsborough Street and Caroline Street, Normanton, Queensland, Australia

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped roof footprint determines the building scale and the lateral position of the covered street edges. The statutory description distinguishes the three parallel bays and the Landsborough Street facade.

note: Queensland Heritage Register entry 602781 specifies the raised floor, roof valleys, central ridge ventilators, window and door stations. The original photograph provides the three decorated parapet curves and profile of the projecting street awnings.
